single_scope: Tighten the existing Binance efficient-trend account's H1 conservative NAV envelope using finer native Binance bars only in every H1 peak/trough window that can exceed the 35% upper-drawdown limit.

periods.full: all hourly marks in the frozen Binance account file

accounting.native_runner_exit_fee_rate: preserve each selected source leg's exit_fee_rate
accounting.full_runner_replacement: For each funded full_runner decision, replace its tp_r=2 child with an exact copy of the original native tp_r=0 path, preserving entry/exit clocks, price, phase, fee class and reason. Leave partial_2_3 events on their original limit and runner paths.

coarse_h1_bounds.lower_nav: For unrefined hours, subtract each intrabar/close exit fee at its actual exit hour from the H1 lower mark; open-phase exits remain represented in open NAV stages.
coarse_h1_bounds.upper_nav: For every H1 hour, include open_nav plus all entry taker fees due during that hour, preserving the pre-entry-fee mark as an upper bound.
coarse_h1_bounds.candidate_scan: Apply these fee bounds across every H1 hour before identifying candidate peak/trough windows. At fine-refined hours, replace the coarse exit-fee subtraction with the native subbar envelope and retain the pre-entry-fee upper mark.

accounting.reconcile: Reconstruct child quantities only from the existing funded position notional and the frozen 2/3 plus 1/3 weights, then verify each event cash PnL, terminal H1 NAV, selected runner path, entry/exit clocks and fees. No account replay or OHLC fill simulation.

resolution.first_pass: For each derived critical peak/trough hour, read the exact active Binance contracts' complete 12 native 5m bars, aggregate them to native Binance H1 OHLC, and apply the existing dd.hour_envelope calculation to the unchanged VectorBT hourly ledger.
resolution.five_minute_source: Existing frozen 5m sources via monday_limit_reclaim_inputs.jobs() and signal_center_score.five_minute(); the source audit identifies Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly klines.
resolution.fallback: Only if the complete 5m upper bound still straddles 35%, use checksum-verified official Binance USD-M daily 1m klines for the same active contracts and exact candidate hours. Do not fetch a broad history.
resolution.h1_integrity: Each refined hour must aggregate exactly to the corrected Binance-native H1 OHLC; the envelope helper also checks the refined end NAV against the frozen H1 NAV.
resolution.fee_bound_integrity: The complete coarse fee-adjusted H1 candidate scan precedes source extraction. Fee deductions are applied only to coarse lower marks after refinement; candidate-window entry-fee upper marks remain in the refined envelope.
resolution.result_rule: Report strict lower/upper drawdown bounds for full and development. If observed_lower_pct <= 35 <= refined_upper_pct after 1m, return unresolved.

limits: This refinement changes no signal, entry, exit, quantity, fee, or cash path; it only narrows the existing H1 intrabar mark envelope.
The H1 candidate scan is run over the complete full and development hourly NAV series before any fine-bar extraction.
No OKX quote or OKX NAV is used in the Binance calculation.
